newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent edge up on slight volume, range trade.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent edge up on slight volume, range trade.

text.p: Brent crude futures trading in Asia were traded higher in late trading on Thursday amid range trading as players await the result of the OPEC meeting in Vienna.
January traded one lot at $22.80 per barrel, up eight cents from London, which fell two cents overnight to $22.72.

Brokers said there was limited interest in the market and they said they doubted there would be any price reaction to an OPEC decision that rolls over quotas. OPEC is currently in a closed door session and ministers have said they expect to come to a decision later on Thursday.
Brokers said they expected January to maintain a trading range of $22.50 to $23.00 in the absence of fresh factors. January traded a range in London of $22.56 to $23.02.
They said news late Wednesday that the United Nations security council sanction committee had formally approved a December pricing formula for Iraq oil exports was factored into the market.
U.S. markets were closed for Thanksgiving Holiday.
